preferred_request_order.request: A lawful digital research copy of the 326-page TMT volume, under any access or use restrictions required.

If original machine-readable transcription/typesetting/database files survive, an author- or institution-approved research copy/export preserving document identifiers and original transcription notation.

If the full source cannot be shared, a fixed transcription-bearing sample selected independently of JANUS hypotheses, preferably a contiguous/pre-existing document range sufficient to establish provenance and at least 10 collision-free identities for technical overlap testing.

provenance_questions_to_resolve_before_R: Which earlier transcription corpus or editorial sources were used to establish each Linear A transcription in TMT?
Were inscriptions independently re-read/re-edited from photographs, facsimiles, autography or primary editions, or transcribed/normalized from GORILA/another existing corpus?
Which document identifier scheme and sign-numbering/transliteration conventions are native to TMT?
Were there systematic corrections or editorial departures from GORILA/Younger that can be mechanically localized?
Do production/source files preserve uncertainty, damage, numerics, ligatures and line/surface boundaries distinctly?
upon_receipt: Run admitted generic source-intake quarantine before content inspection.
Preserve original bytes and compute SHA-256/byte length.
Classify editorial/transcription provenance before assigning L1/L2/L3 status.
Only if provenance and byte receipt pass, create identity-only inventory and execute already-frozen R3B-1 overlap partition.
Do not inspect ku-ro, AB41/si or any other known candidate before the precontent partition is frozen.

suggested_email.subject: Research access request for Testi minoici trascritti (TMT, 1999) transcription material
suggested_email.body:
Dear Professor Negri,

I am conducting a reproducibility-focused computational comparison of Linear A transcription corpora and am writing regarding C. Consani & M. Negri, Testi minoici trascritti, con interpretazione e glossario (Incunabula Graeca 100, CNR, 1999). I found the IULM research record for the 326-page volume, but no digital files are associated with the public record.

If permitted, I would be very grateful for research access to a digital copy of the transcription-bearing volume under any restrictions you specify. If original machine-readable transcription, typesetting, database, or production files survive and can be shared for reproducibility research, an original or author-approved export preserving document identifiers and the source notation would be especially valuable.

A central part of my protocol is provenance: before comparing any individual readings, I need to establish whether the TMT transcription layer was independently re-edited from primary inscription evidence or derived/normalized from earlier corpora such as GORILA, and to preserve the original uncertainty, damage, numeric and boundary notation. I therefore do not ask you to select texts containing any particular proposed word or sign group.

If a full digital source cannot be shared, a fixed transcription-bearing sample chosen independently of my hypotheses, preferably a contiguous or pre-existing range of at least ten identifiable documents, could still support a technical provenance/adapter study.

The material would not be redistributed and any copyright or access conditions would be respected. The purpose is cross-edition reproducibility and transcription robustness, not a decipherment claim.

Thank you very much for your time.

Best regards,
Oleksandr Ahapov / Hawkar
